RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 25

Raising the panel’s gender without concrete evidence of bias will likely backfire, damaging your professional reputation and closing doors to future opportunities. The demographic makeup of an interview panel alone is not proof of discrimination.

For a head of group position, firms frequently prioritize client retention, business development, and strategic leadership over pure technical tenure, provided baseline qualifications like chartership are met. The announcement explicitly highlighted her "excellent client relationships," which is a legitimate commercial rationale. 

Instead of addressing gender, send a polite follow-up inquiry regarding your feedback request, framing it constructively around how you can strengthen your candidacy for future leadership roles.
